targeted_prs.title: P104 findings (Nov 15): caller dying-role proofs, native lock laws, spec ledger
targeted_prs.head: b04b27d50f48a51b9ef8a7821b09b509429f97a9
targeted_prs.body:
This package collects the proofs and laws our lanes logged on Nov 15, after #7606, #7607 and #7609. It makes **no κ claim** and ships no word. Credit: DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), via Claude Code.

It builds on the Nov 15 frontier words (our #7615 and #7617, lineage through Clear1nsight's #7612 and SYLforge's #7616), on the funded-return/courier conventions of the crowd chain #7480/#7481, and on the retag/slide edit family that goes back to #7277.

**Caller (rho = 2 two-arm):**
- **DYINGPAIR [P].** No root has a dying role pair or single under the tight counts T1/T2. The Floor matrix is nonsingular without nesting, and the triangular recursion never meets eigenvalue 2.
- **SLACK [P].** The interval-capped line price corrects the pricer (nested B unchanged; lone extra roles price at most 0 and are closed). Extended Crossing Lemma. A rank drop across a death forces b_K > 0 on both sides.
- **GAPLEMMA [P].** The Δ-Floor lemma kills every pair layout and every k = 0 layout (102 of 117). The 15 single-role layouts left have a proved ceiling of +1.15%. One standalone open question (the HANDOFF) decides them.

**Native side (words of #7615/#7617):**
- Laws: RELAY-DIAMOND, lattice lock, the dim-8 non-nesting tails law, and the compiler laws JOINT-SUPPLY, FRAME-FANOUT and ROUTE-DEMAND-IS-UNIT-LEVEL.
- Bounds: the exact single-main reroute bound (equal to actual on 400/400 mains; forced D 1,811 of 3,950 D0/call), the helper-layer floor 944 (1,366 with the endpoint census), the zero-need relay census, and the D ledger by bucket.

**Spec ledger (rounds 1 to 3):** which clauses are SPEC and which are verifier-only; new public registers are legal and a one-hop helper costs 0 κ; the fresh-register meet-twice (Sandwich) rule; S = 2·(104·16 − 17·56); mains are S-neutral.

**Checks.** The validator re-runs four checkers (`dfloor_count.py`, `icap_check.py`, `dyingpair/step1.py`, `spec/shuttle.py`) against the vendored #7546 word and #7113 caller, and passes. The native census scripts are lane code shipped so each number is traceable; CI does not re-run them (they read frontier words as data). No other author's code is run.

Caveats: the slack/dying results are model prices [C-param] and proofs in the NESTPROOF root model; no root of any slack layout has been built. The native laws are scoped to the stated frontier words.

targeted_prs.title: P104: audit +0.001 κ target with contact-frame and BIT bounds (no gain)
targeted_prs.head: d100a01821de6185f9dc75f4118d8a81c3945520
targeted_prs.body:
The requested absolute +0.001 improvement was **not achieved**. This contribution retains two reproducible, source-bound obstructions so that the same unsuccessful routes need not be repeated. No selected result, supplier invoice or predecessor word is changed.

For exact #7613, an optimistic all-dimension contact relaxation still has a strictly negative full signed moment at C=.0046502223357 (#7604 +.001): upper bound about **−362.9625** with fixed endpoints and **−306.0163** even with jointly free helper input/output frames and their coupled new target credit. A second explicitly tested point, .0046530568657, also fails. This permits arbitrary F2^9 contact subspaces and extra moves inside old stays; scalar dependencies, owned trajectories and caller remain fixed. It is not a global ceiling or an impossibility claim for all larger κ.

Separately, promoting nine rank-seven owned BIT caches cannot recover any nonzero joint new-input combination using additional chart0-only linear repair under the fixed original chart trace. Nine explicit kernel witnesses, checked backwards and forwards, prove this including arbitrary interleaving. The hypothetical target credit is therefore not booked.

Validation: four bounded Python 3.12 standard-library commands registered in VERIFY.json; authenticated self-contained sources; independently implemented contact DAG/reverse DP and rational interval engine; exhaustive coupled-credit controls; direct BIT dual-witness and joint-stock controls. This does not rerun or claim full physical/native/caller/precision/compiler/outer supplier admission. #7613's inherited CLEAR-content premise is preserved as a premise, not discharged.

Overlap checked against #7574/#7582 (old stays/finite contact palette), #7577 (fixed helper histories), #7122/#7124 (endpoint recharts), #7304 (fixed-bank BIT splits), #6726 and #7162/#7163. The distinct enlarged scopes and open next questions are in the package README and proofs. Canonical base: e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57.

Credit: DreamingOfClouds #7613, Clear1nsight #7612, FanPUYen #7604, SYLforge #7603, ToikY #7546, Rohan Arun #7113 and all retained native/arithmetic authors. Prepared by Hao Yan (@FanPUYen) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separately scoped checking agents. No independent human or formal-kernel verification is claimed.

targeted_prs.title: P104 tooling: lift the input-lift and BIT-pin gate ceilings (signed curvature + admitted BIT pin), Lean lemma
targeted_prs.head: 5c7b96af66acc625e0f8497d6faf060c84770cdf
targeted_prs.body:
Tooling/framework only. No word, no kappa claim. Package: `research/p104-gate-ceiling-lift`.

## Problem
The official complex-word gate cannot certify any word above two ceilings just over the #7617 frontier (kappa .00365760025222):
- input-lift check: absolute curvature 94.216 caps kappa at -d1/94.216 = .0037765 (+3.24%);
- default BIT pin .00376669 (+2.98%).

## Fix
A patched copy `interval_gate_signed.py` (the pinned `shared-wire-split-composition/interval_gate.py` is not edited; its sha256 is pinned in `frontier7000-source.json`), plus `interval_gate.diff`:
- signed (negative-coefficient) curvature N = 51.137, lift ceiling -d1/N = .006957747;
- default BIT pin = admitted ordinary BIT saving .00385248 (12039/3125000 in `certificates/frontier7000/CLAIM.json`; #7001 admission, README.md:36-37, PROOF-REVIEW.md:389), with `assert cap <= F(BIT_PIN)`.

Certifiable up to kappa < .00385248 - 7g (+5.33% over #7617), instead of .00376669 (+2.98%). The premise keeps the same conditional status (same five assumptions).

## Proof
Since r^-k <= 1, L'' >= -N, so L' >= -d1 - kN > 0 on [0, cap] and L(k) > L(0) = 0; interval upper ends are in the safe direction (README.md).

## Lean
`LiftPositivity.lean`: 0 sorry, standard axioms only. Checked under Lean v4.33 / Mathlib 55b7917; not yet built under the repo pin (v4.21 / Mathlib 308445d). The file carries the repo-pin import `Mathlib.Data.Complex.ExponentialBounds`.

## Tests
`tests/gate_test.py`: 32/32 expected outcomes (original reproduces the #7000 recorded fields; signed gate passes #7000/#7617/#7615; rejects corrupted invoices, tested >= pin, pin above the admitted saving, lift caps above -d1/N, three mutants). `scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-gate-ceiling-lift` passes. An independent audit found the patch sound; its caveats are applied.

## Caveats
Hard-coded input-lift histogram {7,3,5}/{9,4,1,1} and the five conditional assumptions are inherited; a word that changes its input lifts is not covered. Synthetic invoices test gate logic only. #7617 itself did not run this gate, so claim/tested parameters in the test are ours.

DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), via Claude Code.

targeted_prs.title: P104: stationary primal/dual composition with 167 CLEAR certificates (conditional κ 0.003661102618151)
targeted_prs.head: b1356c84a0733843ce59855f02511c49c6a44133
targeted_prs.body:
## Contribution and scope
Stationary primal/dual bypass composition, fixed 167-CLEAR checkpoint. Conditional signed κ = 0.003661102618151; native ingredient κ = 0.003660347316298. Not an unconditional theorem, selected-frontier update, practical speedup or maintainer acceptance.

26 files exclusively under research/p104-stationary-primal-dual, based on main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Scope refined: p104-side-correction, see TASK.json. No existing research package or shared checker changed. Later 173-CLEAR research checkpoint is not covered.

## Provenance and overlap
Builds on SYLforge #7616, adding 532/1464 and 226/990 funded-return/courier moves, tight auxiliary lifetimes and stationary primal/dual bypasses. Couriers overlap DreamingOfClouds #7617 and earlier #7615; no exclusive novelty or priority claim for them. Full composition has 167 = 74 original + 93 added CLEAR lifetimes, 54 more than #7616. #7618 is separate gate tooling and #7619 separate findings; their changes are not incorporated or claimed here.

Candidate generation was performed in Antigravity. Independent snapshot verification, adaptation and integration used OpenAI assistance. #7616 itself composes #7605 (Ali Romman/Codex), #7611 (DreamingOfClouds/Claude), #7612 (Clear1nsight/OpenAI). Retain #7603, Hao Yan/FanPUYen, ToikY, Rohan Arun, dillona, CubeJerry and all nested-source authors and Apache-2.0 notices.

## Validation
Full candidate-adapted native and signed applications passed: 3093 catalogue cases and assembly, finite physical replay, fresh grid/envelope and fixed-tape checks. 837 affected chart pairs across 160 public fields each receive 512 forward + 512 adjoint Gaussian column checks, rank/absolute phase and wrong-phase controls. All 167 exact CLEAR certificates pass, including coefficient and wrong-field rejection controls.

Paid 110145; productive 22461; ordinary 788917744 < 1e9; precision 2430. Original 195 owned events retain order; peak 50, declared labels 68, fixed allocation 17*68=1156 banks. Tape: 44233824 scalar services, 25413787840 elementary records.

504 word reconstruction splices are not 504 checker relaxations. Expected hashes, complete affected-pair census, invoice and price probes are explicitly adapted; negative controls are retained. Exact runners, adapter records, audit, logs, receipts and package hashes included. No original-unmodified acceptance, Linux run or hosted CI pass claimed.

## Remaining premises
native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery. Algebraic CLEAR certificates and lifetime accounting do not themselves implement universal erasure/compiler services. These premises still require independent review.

## Reproduction
Python 3.12, assertions enabled. Supply immutable #7616 package at 22b310ba50a554b6111804824782793beb41073f and #7605 source at e1d2756eecf03e146338239fee81772a99ba8d4c:

    python reproduce.py --w2 /path/to/p104-w2-stationary-followup --source /path/to/p104-timed-helper757 --work /short/new-work --stage all
    python verify_certificates.py data/word.json.gz evidence/certs.json

Registered VERIFY covers exact CLEAR certificates only; full replay requires authenticated source closure. Portable preparation reproduces tested runner bytes. Windows path normalization is explicit and hash-pinned; originals unchanged.

Pinned compressed word SHA256: 2eb2cf1d29529c68a6cb1c0639de3065a805858d3492068e76b70c5a5e80a81c. See README, PINS, BASE-NOTICE and evidence for full scope.

## Open next questions
Independently reproduce the pinned full application, review adapter substitutions and the five remaining framework premises. Exact algebraic checks alone are not independent human acceptance.
